description: Keyless i18n SDK for React, React Native, Node, Vue, Angular, plain browser (script tag and <i18n-t> web component), Laravel and Flutter: the source string is the key, translations are AI-generated at runtime.
rules: Always import the component as I18nKeylessText (aliased T), never as I18nKeyless.
Call init() once in the entry file before any translation call and before rendering.
storage is required in the browser and in React Native, and optional on the server.
A storage adapter must expose all three of getItem, setItem and removeItem.
Source strings must be written in the primary language; since v3 that can be any of the 48 supported languages.
v3 renamed two language codes: cn became zh-Hans and cz became cs.
Never hardcode the language list; import AVAILABLE_LANGS and the Lang type from the SDK.
getTranslation is a plain function, not a hook: subscribe with useCurrentLanguage() or useI18nKeyless() to re-render.
Keys of the replace map include the literal delimiters, for example { '{name}': user.name }.
In Node, always await awaitForTranslation; fire-and-forget calls hit the 429 rate limit.
Use context to disambiguate meaning and namespace to partition fetch and storage; they are not interchangeable.
Do not leave leading or trailing whitespace inside I18nKeylessText: it changes the translation key.
Under SSR, <T> resolves the language from I18nKeylessProvider while getTranslation resolves it from the runWithI18nKeyless AsyncLocalStorage scope.
Vue: install the I18nKeyless plugin (createApp(App).use(I18nKeyless)) to register <T>; the plugin is I18nKeyless, the component is I18nKeylessText aliased T.
Vue: write replace keys with single braces ({name}); Vue's template compiler owns {{ }}.
Vue: inside a component use t() from useI18nKeyless() or useTranslation(); getTranslation() does not see the plugin or provider scope under SSR.
Angular: add provideI18nKeyless(config) to the root providers; import I18nKeylessTextComponent and I18nKeylessTranslatePipe in each standalone component that uses <i18n-t> or the t pipe.

Angular: the t pipe is impure on purpose so the translation can land; do not add markForCheck calls around it. Wrap a source containing { in an interpolation ({{ 'Bonjour {name}' }}) because Angular reads a bare { as an ICU block.
Angular: storage is optional in the browser (defaults to localStorage); <i18n-t> keeps the source in a hidden span, so use the pipe inside <option>, <title> and attributes.

Browser package: mark text with the data-i18n attribute or the <i18n-t> element; data-i18n replaces the whole text content of the element, so mark leaf elements only, and content inserted later needs translateDom(newNode).
Browser package: the auto script tag needs data-api-key and data-primary; self-hosted files need an import map for the bare i18n-keyless-core specifier.
Laravel: I18N_KEYLESS_API_KEY and I18N_KEYLESS_LANGUAGES are both required in .env; without the languages list, missing strings are never sent.
Laravel: keep Laravel's :name placeholders (__('Bienvenue :name', ['name' => $name])); there is no replace option. Use i18nk('text', context: '...') for a context.
Flutter: init the I18nKeylessClient before runApp and wrap the app in I18nKeylessScope; the widget is T, the string form is context.t(), and Lang is an enum (Lang.zhHans, not 'zh-Hans').
